description: `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`: breaking changes, features, fixes. `^1.2.3` accepts any `1.x` from 1.2.3; `~1.2.3` only `1.2.x`.
`package-lock.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`: exact versions and integrity hashes of the whole tree. Commit it.
Installs exactly what the lockfile lists and fails on a mismatch. The command for CI and Docker builds.
Runtime packages vs tools needed only to build, test or lint. Production installs can omit dev dependencies.
A library declares it uses the host project's copy of a package (for example `react`) instead of bundling its own.
Runs a package's binary without adding it to the project. `pnpm dlx` and `bunx` are the equivalents.
Malicious code delivered through a dependency: typosquatting, hijacked maintainer accounts, install scripts.
